name: Lucas Gallo
source:
Luke was born into wealth. It was not long into his teenage years that he was selling out concerts. He is fabulously wealthy and derives a lot of meaning out of his image; whether real or fake.

Luke has received international acclaim for his charity work for children's hospitals, and utilizes this to heighten his already worshiped persona.

Luke loves being the center of attention, and shows this through his gaudy, outlandish outfits. Can his cocky demeanor and gushing flamboyance be conquered to find the unsure, caring person beneath?
